description: This file defines the LangText class in the SuiteCRM project, which handles language translation and string replacement using global language arrays and module-specific language files.

classes.name: LangText
classes.description: A class responsible for managing language translations, string replacements, and global/local language string resolution within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a LangText object with optional localization parameters.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Public method to retrieve the translated text for the specified key with arguments, possibly throwing or logging errors.

methods.name: resolveText
methods.description: Resolves the translation string based on the current global language arrays and module-specific language files.

methods.name: resolveTextByGlobals
methods.description: Resolves translation strings from global language arrays ($app_strings, $mod_strings, $app_list_strings) based on the 'use' setting.

methods.name: resolveTextByGlobal
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a translation string from a given language array with an optional default.

methods.name: updateTextByModuleLang
methods.description: Attempts to get a translation string from a module-specific language array if the global resolution fails.

methods.name: replaceArgs
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the translation string with actual argument values.

methods.name: selfUpdate
methods.description: Updates the object's key, args, or use properties if new values are provided.

methods.name: getModuleLang
methods.description: Loads the language array for a specific module and language using LanguageManager.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the translation string if called as a string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create a LangText instance and retrieve the translated string.
